sv.title: Tesla rusar när eldrift ökar i Sverige
sv.summary: Den svenska bilmarknaden blir allt mer elektrisk. I oktober var för första gången på fyra år som en majoritet av de nyregistrerade bilarna var elbilar. Amerikanska elbilsbolaget Tesla rusar fram, medan Sveriges största märke Volvo Cars backar kraftigt.

en.title: Tesla surges as electric driving grows in Sweden
en.summary: The Swedish car market is becoming increasingly electric. In October, for the first time in four years, a majority of newly registered cars were electric. The American electric carmaker Tesla is surging ahead, while Sweden's largest brand Volvo Cars is falling sharply.
